facts.fact: The Ghana Statistical Service announced a Pilot Register-Based Education Statistics Project, discussed on 22 July 2026 with the Ministry of Education, Ghana Education Service and National Identification Authority, to produce education statistics continuously from administrative records and track learners.

The Ministry of Education completed a review of Education Management Information System indicators at a 17-18 December 2025 workshop, and stakeholders agreed to integrate the revised indicators into the next national school census.

note: The captured text is a title page, contents and acronym list and states nothing about an education information system.

facts.fact: The GPE programme proposal says Ghana has a functioning Education Management Information System, digitalized since 2022 and disaggregated by sex and disability, collecting data for only 104 of 124 indicators, as confirmed by the ITAP review.

The Ministry of Education's PMDV Dashboard API documentation lists an EMIS schools statistics endpoint returning school counts by level and public or private status, with regional and district filters, and an enrolment rates endpoint.

note: The document describes only a VAT collection mechanism for foreign digital services starting 2026-10-15; it states nothing about this study's questions.

facts.fact: The Ghana Statistical Service and the Ministry of Education released a report on 25 March 2025 analysing enrolment, teachers and performance for 2000-2023 from data in the Education Management Information System.
